name: fdts
comment: Freedraw on the SQUARE-TRIANGLE grid. The base grid is not fixed here: the underlying square-triangle tiling varies per solution and the search enumerates the base tiling and the marking together. Two tiles at one edge length, so "freedraw": true gives both of them free edges over the same pair. Reproduces public/freedraw/ts-solutions-k{1,2,3}.json — 52 / 1098 / 13568 — count for count (its patterns are not on a lattice, so the referee is the dangling-edge filter, not a canonical form). Angles in D=24 units: 90 = 6, 60 = 4.
